name: claude-tube-map
description: Discover, wire up (free, honest tools first), and ride the Claude Research Underground — connect the biomedical MCP servers, public APIs and skills on the map, then take a task journey (bibliography, figures, stats/omics, grant, slides, peer-review, writing, ⚖️ EU/IT/US paralegal). Asks at install which paid/institutional tools you have; checks for updates on entry; routes deep paper writing/review to the free academic-research-skills companion.
